articles.title: Hackers Use NeedyMantis to Maintain Long-Term Access in Breached Networks
articles.description:
Hackers have used a malware family called NeedyMantis to maintain long-term access to networks they had already breached, Microsoft said in a technical analysis.

articles.description:

articles.title: Google Pauses OSS Product Bug Bounty Rewards After Surge in Invalid Automated Reports
articles.description:
Google has stopped accepting product vulnerability reports through its bug bounty program for its open-source software.

articles.description:
